    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActionType
    Enumeration of possible actions a character can take during combat.
    Armour
    Represents armour that can be equipped by characters.
    ArmourFactory
    Factory class for creating armour items.
    ArmourState
    Enumeration representing the condition state of armour equipment.
    Battle
    Manages a battle between the player and one or more enemies.
    BattleGenerator
    Generates battle encounters with enemies based on danger level.
    BattleUI
    UI screen for managing a single battle encounter.
    CharacterCreator
    UI screen for creating a new player character.
    CharacterStatus
    Enumeration representing the health status of a game character.
    DangerLevel
    Enumeration representing the danger level of enemies in the game.
    DeathUI
    UI screen displayed when the player character dies.
    Difficulty
    Enumeration representing game difficulty levels.
    DifficultySelection
    UI screen for selecting game difficulty.
    DisplayInventoryUI
    UI screen for displaying a character's inventory contents.
    DropItemUI
    UI screen for dropping items from the player's inventory.
    Enemy
    Represents an enemy character in the game.
    EnemyFactory
    Factory class for creating enemy characters.
    EnemyGenerator
    Generates fully equipped enemies with gear and healing items appropriate for their danger level.
    EquipItemUI
    UI screen for equipping items from the player's inventory.
    FactoryDemo
     
    GameCharacter
    Base class for all game characters (players and enemies).
    GameLoop
    Main game loop that manages sequential battles.
    GameManager
    Manages global game state and configuration parameters.
    HealingPotion
    Represents a healing potion that can restore a character's health.
    HealingPotionFactory
    Factory class for creating healing potion items.
    Inventory
    Manages a character's inventory of items.
    Item
    Base class for all items in the game.
    ItemActionSelectionUI
    UI screen for selecting an action to perform on inventory items.
    ItemRarity
    Enumeration representing the rarity levels of items in the game.
    ItemUsageUI
    Abstract base class for UI screens that perform actions on inventory items.
    LootUI
    UI screen for managing post-battle looting.
    Main
    Main entry point for the game application.
    MainMenu
    Main menu UI screen for the game.
    Player
    Represents a player character in the game.
    PlayerStatsUI
    UI screen for displaying comprehensive player character statistics.
    RestUI
    UI screen for resting between battles.
    SelectItemUI
    UI screen for selecting items from a character's inventory.
    Shield
    Represents a shield item that can be equipped by characters.
    ShieldFactory
    Factory class for creating shield items.
    StatAllocationUI
    UI screen for allocating available stat points to character attributes.
    TurnUI
    UI screen for managing a single combat turn.
    UIHelper
    Utility class providing common UI functions for displaying game elements and handling user input throughout the game.
    UseAvailableStatPointsUI
    UI screen for using available stat points on a player character.
    UseItemUI
    UI screen for using consumable items from the player's inventory.
    UserInterface
    Abstract base class for all user interface screens in the game.
    Weapon
    Represents a weapon item that can be equipped by characters.
    WeaponFactory
    Factory class for creating weapon items.
